narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the log file.
finalText:
**Redis died at 02:14:07. Everything else fell after it.**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` at [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182) |
| 02:14:07 | `cache layer degraded — falling back to direct store reads` |
| 02:29:12 | `request queue depth 502 (max 500)` |
| 02:31:44 | `JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)` |
| 02:31:52 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` at [logs/app.log:719](logs/app.log:719) |

13 reconnect tries. All refused. None worked.

Last good request was 02:14:03. Nothing served after.

Counts: 173 `TimeoutError`, 174 cache miss storms, 188 `ERROR`.

Backoff was flat at 80s. No load shedding. Queue grew past cap.

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` refuses connections.
